newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA HAS FIM 70 MLN REAL ESTATE GAINS.
newsitem.headline: MERITA HAS FIM 70 MLN REAL ESTATE GAINS.

text.p: Finnish bank group Merita Oy said in a statement on Monday it had sold real estate worth about 600 million markka in 1996 and that it had booked gains of over 70 million markka on the deals.

"The value of real estate sold by Merita Kiinteistot Oy and its subsidiaries this year ... totals about 600 million markka. Over 70 million markka of profits have been booked on the deals," Merita said.
A spokesman said by telephone the figure did not include the bank's sales of real estate held as collateral.
Merita Kiinteistot holds all Merita's real estate, he said.
Most recently, Merita Kiinteistot had signed an agreement to sell real estate in the Hague, Amsterdam and Veldhoven in Netherlands worth 180 million markka in total, Merita said in the statement.
In July-August, Merita also sold two sites worth 140 million markka together in the Brussels area in Belgium, it said.
